purpose: Research manifest for the extra ACE-Step 1.5 audio encoder and FSQ tokenizer; not used by the app.

provenance.source_file_sha256: Both complete local files were hashed and matched the official Hugging Face API LFS SHA-256 metadata for the pinned revision.
provenance.range_sha256: Computed locally from the corresponding complete source file after whole-file hash verification; these are not separately published official hashes.
provenance.remote_probe: Each complete region was streamed directly from the pinned official revision without saving a file. Both returned HTTP 206, the expected Content-Range and Content-Length, and SHA-256 matching the locally derived range digest. This checks the remote bytes against our digest; the range digests are not separately published official metadata.

limitations: This file is research only: no model downloader, converter, or runtime is wired into the app.
A downloaded range is a raw tensor-data slice, not a complete safetensors file; validated headers, tensor shapes and offsets are still needed.
The VAE requires weight-normalization folding and Conv1d layout conversion; the tokenizer requires checked keys and a supported BF16 or converted dtype.
The precise per-tensor integrity, streaming conversion, peak iPhone memory, Swift/MLX correctness and end-to-end audio quality have not been tested.
A signed redirect or server may reject range requests or ignore Range; a future implementation must check status, Content-Range, length and digest and avoid silently downloading the full source.
